relations.evidence: rikhita śrī 3 paradṛteyā śrī 3 viṣṇuchebāhārayā varjācāryya śrīsighavila gubhājuna, themiddeśayā thvavu torayā dhijaviranaṃ thva puṣṭaka cokāo kayādina jura

notes: Scribe is a Vajrācārya (Gubhāju) of Viṣṇuche(ṃ) Bāhāra in Paradṛte (perhaps Palānchok or a locality name). The patron who had it copied ('cokāo kayā') is Dhijavira of Thvavutola in Thimi.
